meta.name: Kaalipotka
meta.description:
In a gritty urban jungle, four women - Srima, Rani, Rinku, and Minoti - are drawn into chaos after Minoti's husband's freak accident. A cover-up spirals into deceit, murder, and revenge as ex-con Rana and the police hunt them

Returning Series · First aired 23 Jan 2026 · IN · Language: Bengali
Studio: Edgy Entertainment

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

On your server — Audio: Bengali

videos.title: Barood
videos.overview: Srima, Rani, Rinku, and Minoti are close friends always busy trying to avoid businessman Rana and loan recovery agent Mona. All their troubles escalate with Minoti’s husband’s accidental death.

videos.title: Deshlai
videos.overview: Minoti turns to Srima for support, who pulls Rani and Rinku into a web of shared responsibilities. However, with secrets, money, and loyalty closely linked, chaos blows out of control very quickly.

videos.title: Solte
videos.overview: The police investigation gets more twisted with the emergence of new clues. With pressure building around Minoti, Srima creates a plan with Rani and Rinku’s help to shift suspicion away from her.

videos.title: Agun
videos.overview: The bond between the four women gets tested when the financial pressure and secrets from the past reach an all-time high. With the police getting closer, Srima’s sharp instincts are put to a test.

videos.title: Phulki
videos.overview: The women’s attempt to rebuild their lives fails with a shocking event. Strange incidents make them feel watched and unsafe. Facing all the demons from their past, they wonder what lies ahead.

videos.title: Shihoron
videos.overview: Rani’s life turns chaotic as a masked attacker appears with a warning. Cornered and desperate, the women come together again to face the danger that threatens to change everything.

videos.title: Dhamaka
videos.overview: The stakes rise with the return of a furious and vengeful Rana. The women are forced to take the dangerous and unpredictable path that leads them to a confrontation. Will the four survive or perish?
